project_name: MyGenie Customer App - QR Restaurant Ordering
target_viewport: Mobile-first QR scan ordering (~390px - 480px width, max 600px container)
scope: Two specific UI features across MenuItems and ReviewOrder: BUG-002 (Search ranking flat list + category tag + empty state) and CR-002 (APS - As Per Size badge on MenuItem card and OrderItemCard/ReviewOrder)

bug_002_flat_search_result_list.context: When searchQuery is non-empty in MenuItems.jsx, switch from per-category grouped sections (with category headers) to a single flat ranked list without category headers.

ranking_algorithm.rule: Flatten items across all sections, filter out invalid/unavailable/channel-ineligible items, then sort by relevance tiers:
tiers: Tier 1 (Score 1): Item name starts with search query
Tier 2 (Score 2): Item name contains search query (partial substring)
Tier 3 (Score 3): Item description contains search query
Tier 4 (Score 4+): Fallback POS food_order or natural array sequence
ranking_algorithm.in_cart_prioritization: Within the ranked list, items already in cart remain accessible or float smoothly without disrupting tier-0 exact match prominence.

category_indicator_design.condition: Rendered when item has `categoryName` prop or when search is active (`isSearchMode={true}`).
category_indicator_design.placement: Directly above item name or adjacent to veg/non-veg dot indicator in the card's headerBlock.

badge_spec.classes: inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] font-medium text-gray-600 bg-gray-100 rounded border border-gray-200 mb-1 max-w-fit
badge_spec.icon: Optional tiny fork-and-knife or tag icon (10px) before category name

search_meta_banner.placement: Top of flat results list, directly below SearchAndFilterBar
search_meta_banner.classes: px-4 py-2.5 bg-gray-50/80 border-b border-gray-100 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-gray-600
search_meta_banner.clear_action: Button 'Clear search' to instantly restore category grouped browse view

empty_state_design.container_classes: empty-search-state flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 px-6 text-center bg-white my-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm

icon.wrapper: w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-orange-50 flex items-center justify-center mb-4 text-[#E8622A]
icon.symbol: Search icon with small question mark or utensil (e.g., FiSearch or IoSearchOutline, size 28px)

description.text: We couldn't find anything matching "{searchQuery}". Check for typos or try searching for another dish or ingredient.

action_button.classes: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-[#FFF4ED] text-[#E8622A] hover:bg-[#FEEADF] font-semibold text-xs border border-[#FED7C3] transition-colors shadow-xs

cr_002_aps_badge.context: Variable price items in POS are marked with price = 1 (or parseFloat(item.price) === 1). They represent seasonal or weighable delicacies (e.g. seafood, fish, whole crab, butcher cuts) where price is confirmed upon order at counter/reception. Showing ₹1 is confusing and looks like a system error. Replace ₹1 with an 'APS' (As Per Size) badge across MenuItem card and ReviewOrder.

location_a_menu_item_card.replacement:
In MenuItem headerBlock: replace `
₹{item.price}
` with APS Badge container when `isAPS(item.price)` is true.

styling.container: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 py-0.5 px-2 bg-[#FFF4ED] border border-[#FED7C3] rounded-md text-[#E8622A] max-w-fit mt-0.5
styling.tooltip_note: Price confirmed at counter / upon preparation

visual_structure.add_button_behavior: ADD button remains fully active and operational. Customer taps ADD normally. Cart quantity increments normally. No blocking modal or required confirmation prompt at menu stage.

location_b_order_item_card_review_page.replacement:
In OrderItemCard right column: replace `
₹{itemPrice.toFixed(2)}
` with APS label when item is APS (check `cartItem.item.price === 1` or `cartItem.unitPrice === 1`).

styling.badge: inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#FFF4ED] text-[#E8622A] border border-[#FED7C3] font-bold text-[11px] tracking-wide

location_c_review_order_bill_breakdown_n.context: When one or more items in cart have isAPS === true, show a reassuring contextual informational note above or inside the Price Breakdown card so guests understand their bill has variable items.
location_c_review_order_bill_breakdown_n.copy: ℹ️ Note: 1 item has variable pricing (APS - As Per Size). Final price for this item will be confirmed at the counter/table.
location_c_review_order_bill_breakdown_n.styling: p-2.5 mb-3 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-lg text-xs text-amber-800 flex items-start gap-2

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. IMPLEMENT BUG-002: In `frontend/src/pages/MenuItems.jsx`, when `searchQuery.trim().length > 0`, do NOT render category-grouped headers. Instead, flatten all items from all categories into one single list, apply existing filters (availability, timing, channel), sort with relevance ranking (Tier 0: exact name, Tier 1: prefix, Tier 2: substring, Tier 3: description), and pass `categoryName` to each item.

2. IMPLEMENT SEARCH CATEGORY TAG: In `frontend/src/components/MenuItem/MenuItem.jsx`, accept `categoryName` (or `isSearchMode`) and render a compact category pill badge (`data-testid="search-item-category-tag"`) above or beside the item name when search is active.

3. IMPLEMENT SEARCH EMPTY STATE: In `frontend/src/pages/MenuItems.jsx`, when search query is active and returns 0 items, render the dedicated empty state with `data-testid="empty-search-state"`, an icon, clear explanation, and a 'Clear Search' button that resets `searchQuery` to ''.

4. IMPLEMENT CR-002 APS BADGE IN MENU ITEM: In `frontend/src/components/MenuItem/MenuItem.jsx`, check `parseFloat(item.price) === 1`. If true, render the APS badge container (`data-testid="menu-item-aps-badge"`) displaying 'APS (As Per Size)' instead of '₹1'. Preserve all other elements (veg dot, name, description, ADD button).

5. IMPLEMENT CR-002 APS BADGE IN ORDER ITEM: In `frontend/src/components/OrderItemCard/OrderItemCard.jsx`, check `parseFloat(cartItem.item?.price) === 1`. If true, replace `₹{itemPrice.toFixed(2)}` in the right column with the APS badge (`data-testid="order-item-aps-badge"`) showing 'APS' and subtext 'As Per Size'.

6. KEEP MONEY LOGIC UNTOUCHED: POS receives `price: 1` as-is. Do NOT modify CartContext total calculations, orderService payloads, or payment gateway amounts. The APS badge is strictly a customer-facing display change.
7. DATA-TESTID CONVENTION: Add all prescribed `data-testid` attributes without exception to ensure robust automated test coverage.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.color_discipline: Adhere strictly to brand primary #E8622A (MyGenie Orange) and its tints (#FFF4ED, #FED7C3). Never introduce random purple, neon green, or arbitrary gradient fills.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Avoid generic cards. In search mode, maintain tight, scannable list hierarchy. In APS badges, use deliberate typographic contrast: bold uppercase micro-caps for 'APS' paired with subtle humanist subtext 'As Per Size'.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_and_accessibility: APS badge text #E8622A on #FFF4ED has high contrast. Category tag #4B5563 on #F3F4F6 exceeds 4.5:1 WCAG AA. Never use transparent backgrounds under readable text.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.layout_integrity: Maintain mobile-first padding (12px to 16px). For no-image cards and image cards, keep ADD button aligned consistently. Ensure category tag does not push item name off alignment.
